image_description: Two men standing on a boat holding a very large sturgeon horizontally. The background features a river and mountains under an overcast sky. The sturgeon is the primary subject, displaying characteristic bony scutes along its side.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gray, brown, or black dorsally with lighter ventral surface.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the scutes appears slightly overly smooth and plastic-like compared to the rough, keratinous nature of real sturgeon armor. There is a slight lack of micro-detail in the gaps between scutes.

The hand gripping the front of the fish appears somewhat fused with the fish's body. The fingers lack clear definition and seem to merge into the gray skin of the fish, suggesting a minor generation artifact in the contact zone.
The geometry of the boat console and seat behind the man on the right is slightly warped, with lines that do not converge logically, typical of AI background generation.
